emails.subject: Resource for your conversion optimization page
emails.body:
Hi,

I saw your Conversion Optimization category lists tools for store owners, but nothing on how to work out why a store is not converting in the first place.

I'm a Shopify CRO designer and I wrote a short guide that walks through it in order: traffic, product page, cart, mobile. It uses no vendor pitch and no affiliate links.

Would it be a fit for that page? Happy to send it over.
Hi, just checking you saw my note about the diagnosis guide for your Conversion Optimization page. No problem if it is not a fit.
